title: Outcome Fingerprint — Daily KPI Log
content:
Purpose: lightweight daily log to track the 'outcome fingerprint' for short work bursts (3–10 day micro-sprints). Not a full OKR — this is experimental: surface a 1‑line outcome, 2 leading indicators, a single experiment, and a confidence index.

Format (daily entry):
- date: YYYY-MM-DD
- outcome (1 line): what success looks like for today
- leading indicators (measurable): 1) metric/threshold, 2) metric/threshold
- experiment / micro-step: one thing to try; hypothesis and expected signal (5–15m / can be production safe)
- confidence (0–100): how likely it is this will matter to the weekly outcome
- notes / blockers / next steps: quick bullets, unresolved questions, links

-- Sample entries (live scratch) --
2025-02-24
- outcome: reduce median inference tail latency for small text-gen jobs by 10% on staging route
- leading indicators: 1) p95 latency for 64-token calls < 210ms (baseline 235ms), 2) avg GPU utilization on pool-a < 62%
- experiment: enable kernel micro-fusion for attention on model-x-small (toggle + quick perf run) — hypothesis: single-kernel fused attention reduces kernel launch overhead and improves p95 by ~8–12%
- confidence: 60
- notes: quick test harness in /bench/mini-runner -> run 1000 requests with seq=64. Slack: #perf-run thread referencing GH-PR 78. If improvement <5% maybe try tiny-batching (2). Blocker: need staging pool with quantized variant deployed (ask Rafi).

2025-02-26
- outcome: stabilize daily habit of logging micro-experiments (goal: 5/7 days this week)
- leading indicators: 1) number of days logged >= 4, 2) at least one experiment produces measurable delta (>=5%)
- experiment: use mobile reminder + 10-minute Pomodoro at 11:30am to force the entry; record in this doc immediately after
- confidence: 75
- notes: realized friction is context switching — keep experiments <= 15m. Link: /confluence/habit-templates (draft).

Mini-retro (2025-02, week view):
- wins: kept to 3 days of entries, one perf change produced p95 improvement of 9% (kernel micro-fusion on model-x-small).
- learnings: must include a quick automation: perf run + metrics extraction -> upload to GH gist, otherwise manual copy is the friction point.
- hypothesis for next week: remove manual steps and add a tiny script that pushes p95 and avg util to a single CSV. Expected to convert 60% of manual checks into automatic signals.
- next actions: (A) write script (30–60m), (B) ask infra to provision temporary staging pool with quant variant (ticket PROD-8421), (C) schedule a 20m sync with Rafi to unblock.

Decision log (one-liners):
- 2025-02-25: keep kernel micro-fusion as default for x-small on staging. Rationale: measurable p95 win and no error increase. Assigned: Rafi (follow-up to production gating).
- 2025-02-28: iterate on reminder cadence — try daily at 11:30 for 2 weeks. Owner: me.

Metrics dashboard snapshot (manual entries for now):
- baseline p95 (2025-02-20): 235ms
- post-fusion p95 (2025-02-25): 214ms
- change: -9%
- days logged (week of 2025-02-24): 3/7

Backlog: micro experiments I'd like to try (brain dump)
- tiny-batching (2 requests) impact on token cost vs latency tradeoff
- prefix caching sanity check with 8-token contexts — measure cache hit ratio
- small quantization profile (int8-ish) on dev pool — verify degredation on worst-case prompts
- evaluate model-x-small vs model-y-tiny on average token cost for short chat replies

Unresolved questions / prompts to self:
- What minimum signal should I accept as "worth deploying"? 5% p95 seems okay for latency-first paths, but for cost maybe need 10%
- Is the mini-runner representative of real traffic distribution? probably not — need a quick script to replay traces from prod anonymized (ask SRE)
- Time budget: can I reliably reserve 45–60m/week for these micro-experiments without blocking product work? Try hard.

Quick checklist for an experiment (copy/paste):
- [ ] Define one-line outcome and two leading indicators
- [ ] Write micro-runner script and run 1k requests
- [ ] Capture p50/p95/avg and GPU util to CSV/gist
- [ ] Post results to #perf-run with 1-line TL;DR and link to gist/PR
- [ ] Decide: roll forward / iterate / abandon (record decision in this doc)

Daily habit notes (meta):
- keep entries terse (1–6 bullets)
- prefer signal over storytelling — numbers first, notes second
- capture friction points immediately (automation, missing infra, permissions)

References & quick links:
- PR for metrics probes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics-probes/pull/78
- Ticket to provision staging quant pool: JIRA:PROD-8421
- Slack: #perf-run (thread: "kernel-fusion-quicktest")
- Confluence draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/12345

Notes to self (stream-of-thought):
- low cognitive load wins: the fewer fields I have to fill the more likely I will keep doing it. If the daily checklist > 5 items I won't.
- reward loop: when a micro-experiment yields a measurable delta, add a quick celebratory emoji to Slack and mark it in this doc — reinforces habit.
- long-term: collect 8–12 experiments and then run a short retrospective to create an owner-backed rollout plan (20–30m).

-- end --
